description.p: A simple editor for text documents, in the spirit of macOS TextEdit.

ul.li: Opens plain text in any common encoding and keeps its line endings
Rich text with fonts, colours, alignment and lists; RTF, Markdown and HTML
Opens and saves Word (.docx) and OpenDocument (.odt) documents
Find and replace, with regular expressions
Documents are saved automatically and come back after a crash or quit
Opens large log files without stalling
